messages:
alex: Quick q — we've got some orgs reporting doubled token usage in the console when they pass both an API key and an org-id header. Repro steps small: client sets Authorization: Bearer <key> and X-Org-ID: org_ABC; console shows usage against both org_ABC and the key's org. Anyone seen this?

tim: hmm not on prod, maybe a routing fallback is tagging both? can you paste a minimal request log?

alex: sure, here's the inbound trace (redacted):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer sk-abc123
X-Org-ID: org_ABC
Content-Type: application/json
{...payload...}
```
console shows billing entries: org_ABC + owner_of(sk-abc123)

maria: that sounds like the claim-resolution code: we try org header -> if present we map to org-level entitlement, but there was a GC bug where per-key attribution wasn't cleared when both were present. Lina fixed something similar last quarter. @lina any recollection?

lina: yea we had a race where request context carried both claim objects and both serializers emitted metrics. quick fix was to prioritize org header and set key claim to null before emit. but that was only applied in the hosted path, not the private runtime. are these customers on Private?

alex: hosted.

lina: oh. then maybe the hotfix didn't get to the routing branch that handles header-based routing. I'll grep for `clear_key_claim()` in routing-plugin.

quota-bot: Automated alert: duplicate-claim-detection triggered for org_ABC at 2024-09-12T14:03:12Z — 7 occurrences in 5m :warning:

maria: timeline: if hotfix wasn't shipped, two emitters (metering and per-route telemetry) could record the same tokens under different owner tags. short term: we should add a dedupe tag by request_id in billing pipeline. medium term: ensure claim canonicalization happens at ingress.

tim: agree. quick mitigation: we can add a filter in the billing consumer that collapses entries with same request_id and same token ranges. low risk and fast. I'll draft a consumer patch.

alex: ok pls also add a console note for affected orgs (cc product) so support doesn't panic. we should avoid a rollback if possible. :+1:

lina: will open a routing PR today to null the key claim when X-Org-ID exists. also adding unit test for Private/Hosted parity.

maria: thanks. follow-ups: 1) telemetry ticket for dedupe 2) postmortem blameless 3) small dashboard metric: percent of requests with both key+org headers so we can monitor.

alex: perfect. I'll file the support note and link this thread. thanks all.
